## Design

### 2026-10-07 – ![image_2026-10-07_212506751](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/Uuv3M8G8C0wZWdKzwccgHD3HxqvGBTkn/b206099fb7806f8980da2485c07df783c0d7b7c3bdde83b6a1db83fc2d2fe0e5.png)

**1.32h**

![image_2026-10-07_212506751](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/Uuv3M8G8C0wZWdKzwccgHD3HxqvGBTkn/b206099fb7806f8980da2485c07df783c0d7b7c3bdde83b6a1db83fc2d2fe0e5.png)

I finished a basic first schematic for a simple distortion pedal. Also began layout for pcb design. It take an input from an audio jack and outputs a clipped signal that can be plugged into a guitar amp. No tracks yet; just a rough idea for layout.

![image_2026-10-07_212423692](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/Uuv3M8G8C0wZWdKzwccgHD3HxqvGBTkn/02d05bf393ff706aad2c3e5a4ae16e05d78617c350c5ad220ab8e11b79ef8698.png)
